## Summary
Anas Ali is a Full-Stack Software Engineer, Machine Learning Specialist, and Robotics Engineer based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. He is currently pursuing a Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Science & Engineering (2023 - 2027) at Government Engineering College, Jaipur.

His engineering expertise spans high-performance modern web architectures (React 18, Next.js 15, Node.js, Supabase), deep learning and artificial intelligence (PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, Generative AI, LangChain, Gemini API), and embedded systems robotics (ESP32, Arduino C++, SolidWorks, Blynk IoT).

## Featured Engineering Projects
1. AI Finance Manager
   - Stack: Next.js 15, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, Supabase, Inngest, Clerk, Prisma, Arcjet, Resend, Gemini API.
   - Architecture: Client (Next.js 15) -> Clerk Auth -> Inngest Background Workers -> Gemini Flash OCR Parser -> Supabase PostgreSQL via Prisma.
   - Key Features: Automated OCR receipt scanning, cron-scheduled recurring transactions, automated ledger categorization, and bot attack mitigation.
   - Repository: https://github.com/syAnasali/AI-Finance-Manager

2. Jarvis AI Assistant (Local LLMs & Autonomous Desktop Control)
   - Stack: Python 3.13, Ollama (qwen2.5:7b / qwen3:8b), PySide6 (Qt GUI), faster-whisper, pyttsx3, SQLite (WAL Mode), Pydantic, Loguru.
   - Architecture: User Interface (PySide6 GUI / Push-to-Talk Voice / Terminal CLI) -> AgentController & Heuristic Router -> TaskPlan Sequential Runtime -> Hybrid Memory Retriever -> Local LLM via Ollama -> 23 System Tools with Synchronized Action Approval Runtime.
   - Key Features: 100% offline-first local LLM inference, real-time word-by-word streaming token accumulator, multi-type persistent memory (fact, preference, project context), 23 built-in filesystem, desktop, and window automation tools, blocking confirmation dialog for risky system actions, offline voice loop, and 78.9% prompt context compression.
   - Repository: https://github.com/syAnasali/jarvis-ai-assistant

3. Model Wall-E Perception Car
   - Stack: ESP32 Microcontroller, Arduino C++, Blynk IoT, Ultrasonic Sensors, SolidWorks CAD, L298N Driver.
   - Architecture: Ultrasonic & IR Sensors -> ESP32 Microcontroller -> L298N Motor Driver -> Blynk IoT Real-Time Telemetry.
   - Key Features: Low-latency Wi-Fi telemetry (<20ms latency), obstacle perception math, autonomous collision avoidance, and 3D printed chassis.
   - Repository: https://github.com/syAnasali/RCAT-Robotics-and-Automation

4. Pixel_Info: AI Image Caption Generator
   - Stack: PyTorch, TorchVision, ResNet50, LSTM, FastAPI, Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, CUDA.
   - Architecture: Image Upload (Next.js 15) -> FastAPI REST (POST /caption) -> ResNet50 Feature Extractor (2048-dim) -> PyTorch LSTM Decoder (Beam Search k=3, α=0.75) -> Natural Language Caption JSON.
   - Key Features: Transfer learning CNN visual encoder, custom Xavier-initialized LSTM sequence decoder, Beam Search decoding boosting BLEU-4 by +10.99% and vocabulary diversity by +14.63%, single-load cached FastAPI model lifecycle, and GPU CUDA acceleration.
   - Repository: https://github.com/syAnasali/Pixel_Info

5. BillFlow SaaS Billing Engine
   - Stack: Next.js 15 App Router (React 19), TypeScript, Supabase (PostgreSQL with RLS), Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, @react-pdf/renderer.
   - Architecture: Client (Next.js 15) -> Cookie SSR Middleware (Supabase Auth) -> Server Actions (Monetary Validation) -> Supabase PostgreSQL (RLS) -> @react-pdf/renderer (Server A4 PDF Stream).
   - Key Features: Decoupled SaaS billing engine, dynamic spreadsheet with reactive math, tamper-proof server-side recalculation, historical invoice snapshot immutability, server-side PDF generator, financial SaaS dashboard metrics (Paid revenue, outstanding balances, draft tracking).
   - Live URL: https://bill-flow-neon.vercel.app/
   - Repository: https://github.com/syAnasali/BillFlow

6. News Aggregator App (Android)
   - Stack: Java, Android XML, Material Design Components, Glide, XmlPullParser, HttpURLConnection.
   - Architecture: BBC News RSS Feed -> Background HttpURLConnection Worker -> XmlPullParser -> NewsItem Model -> RecyclerView with Glide Image Cache -> Progress-Aware In-App WebView.
   - Key Features: Real-time RSS ingestion, non-blocking background threads, Facebook Shimmer skeleton loading screens, swipe-to-refresh feed update, automatic dark mode, and in-app reader.
   - Repository: https://github.com/syAnasali/NewsAggregatorApp

7. Crop Prediction System

   - Architecture: Agricultural Parameters (NPK, Temperature, Humidity, Rainfall) -> Flask API Server -> Random Forest / XGBoost Classifier -> Crop Recommendation.
